dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: First, keep smiling, and when clients arrive, remember to greet them...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Then, introduce designs and colors to them based on their needs...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Well, that's everything memorized. We should be fine now... right?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Come on, Kachina. Mualani's put her trust in you, so you can't mess this up. You can do it! You totally can!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: #Ah! W—Welcome to "Leisurely Puffer" Water Sports Shop... Huh? {NICKNAME}, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you manning the store?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, Mualani's gonna be leading tours over the next couple of days. She left to start prep work today, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: So that left the shop without staff. Now, she did say that closing it for a while would be okay...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: But since I happened to be free, I thought I'd do something for a friend. And I might open a cake shop someday, so getting some experience now couldn't hurt.

choices.text: I'd say you reacted quickly and carried yourself well just now.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Aw... Thanks for the encouragement. Mualani said something similar before... I—I know I can do this!

choices.text: Then I'll leave you to it.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Sure! See you later!

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: ...Aahhh, delicious. Hey, Kinich. What are you idling around for? Come forth and serve the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw some more Quenepa Berry juice at once!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Busy right now.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Ba-loney! You're not doing a thing right now! Kachina will be fine — serving your lord drinks is a far more pressing issue.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Not if there's none left.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: What!? How could it have gone so fast!? I've barely had a few sips! Wasn't there a whole bottle? You drank some behind my back, didn't you, Kinich!?

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Not that there was any need.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Wh—Why you... you stubborn brat... Anyway! Hurry up and find that little rascal Mualani, and have her bring three more pitchers of juice as tribute to our eminent personage!

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: This was barely enough to wet our royal lips!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Come on. Let's go say hello.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: #We meet again, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Yeah, Mualani asked me to keep an eye on her while she minds the shop alone.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: She asked both of us, you self-centered little... minion! The Almighty Dragonlord and his accomplishments shall not be overlooked!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Then let all know that the mighty Ajaw spent all our advance payment before we could even finish the commission.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A mighty deed indeed.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Kinich, you little...!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: ...Ah. It seems like our job is done. It's about time for us to—

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Eh? Leaving so soon? Not on my watch! Good thing I sped up my preparations and got back early. Juuust a little worried, you know?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #But since we've run into each other, let's go grab some dinner together to celebrate Kachina's first time managing a shop solo! {NICKNAME}, you should join us too!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Look, Kachina's spotted us! Oh, and by the way, there'll be lots of iced Quenepa Berry Juice at the dinner — my treat!

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Ahem. Then I, K'uhul Ajaw, shall deign to accept this invitation.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And so goes another lively day in Natlan.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: ...Let's go, then.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yay! Kachina, over here, over here~

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Coming, Mualani!

choices.text: Are you here to check on Kachina?
Let's meet again once you get off work.
I believe in you too, Kachina!
